textureModification: None: byte-for-byte copy of the original RGBA texture.
reference: The original ray particle has zero start speed, a one-second lifetime, size 0.2–0.65, and a size-over-life curve. The prefab also contains two transient line layers and a separate circle layer.
adaptation: Godot CPUParticles3D reuses the original ray texture on horizontal water-level planes. It uses sparse, independently randomized births, zero speed/gravity, mint-white opacity and size envelopes, and 0.55m clearance from the baked cliff contact line. Terrain and cats retain depth occlusion. This adapts the source texture and twinkle behavior; it does not execute the Unity prefab.
